command:
BB=/bin/busybox
echo STATUS_BEGIN
for f in /proc/ssboot/state /proc/ssboot/mode /proc/ssboot/resmode /proc/udm/upm_bootmode /sys/power/image_mode /sys/power/image_dev /sys/module/warm/parameters/resume_drop /sys/module/warm/parameters/boot_drop /sys/module/warm/parameters/ignore_drop; do
 if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "PATH=$f"; $BB cat "$f" 2>&1; fi
done
echo BOOT_MESSAGES
$BB dmesg 2>&1 | $BB grep -iE 'WARMBOOT|SSBI|snapshot|ssboot|resume from' | $BB sed -n '1,20p'
echo STATUS_END
response:
STATUS_BEGIN
PATH=/proc/ssboot/state
snapshot
PATH=/proc/ssboot/mode
optimize
PATH=/proc/ssboot/resmode
normal
PATH=/proc/udm/upm_bootmode
NORM
PATH=/sys/power/image_mode
2
PATH=/sys/power/image_dev
*wbi4
PATH=/sys/module/warm/parameters/resume_drop
0
PATH=/sys/module/warm/parameters/boot_drop
N
PATH=/sys/module/warm/parameters/ignore_drop
Y
BOOT_MESSAGES
STATUS_END
